statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 21% sits in the watch band, below the 25% block threshold, while Stress 54% remains elevated.
recommendation: Conditions are elevated-stress but mean-reverting: the opening hour produced a genuine retracement, VIX has decayed from its high and both the 10-year and 30-year yields sit at the low end of today's ranges. The narrow published danger window covers the 17:00Z seven-year note auction and its immediate aftermath.
headline: Nasdaq-100 retraces off its opening low as long-end yields and VIX both back away from session highs
body:
NDX cash trades near 30,311, about -0.52% on the day, inside a 30,204 to 30,334 session range roughly an hour into the US cash day. The index sits near the upper end of that range after the opening low, so session-extreme holding and opening-auction continuation are not observed. NQ December futures near 30,578 (-0.61%) hold about 208 points above the 30,370 overnight low within a 30,370-30,813 range, leaving price near the middle rather than at an extreme. The 10-year yield at 5.09% and the 30-year at 5.39% are both at the low end of their 5.09-5.13 and 5.39-5.43 daily ranges after the 30-year touched a post-2004 high of about 5.438% earlier in the session, so this week's long-end selloff is pausing rather than extending today. VIX near 15.58 is up about 2.6% but has decayed well below its 16.57 session high.

The counterweights are real but do not currently describe a pathological price path. WTI crude near $94.35 is up about 2.4% and close to its $94.68 session high as hopes for a diplomatic resolution in the US-Iran track fade, keeping an inflation channel open. New York Fed President Williams described a further rate increase by year end as reasonable, and market-implied odds of an October move are around 69%. August new home sales released at 14:00Z came in at a 684,000 annual rate, a 6.4% monthly rise and above consensus, which supports the resilient-demand read that has been feeding the rate repricing. Shared Finviz context collected at 12:21Z is now about two hours old and therefore stale under the provider contract; its latest-session, non-real-time breadth showed all eight tracked megacaps lower and semiconductors down about 1.8% on average, which is used here only as confirmation of a negative equity backdrop and not as evidence of current NQ structure.

Taken together, the evidence shows an elevated-stress environment in which retracement is still functioning: prices are recovering off lows, volatility is decaying, and the rate impulse that drove the past two sessions is stalling. Tail eases to 21% from 24% at the previous hour on that observed retracement. Stress stays elevated at 54% because oil, the hawkish Fed repricing and weak latest-session breadth remain unresolved. The published danger window is kept narrow around the 17:00Z seven-year note auction, which into a long end at multi-decade highs is the most specific credible delayed-second-leg mechanism remaining in the session.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours ran from an orange print at 25% Tail during Wednesday's US afternoon, through a yellow overnight plateau near 20-24% Tail, down to three green hours between 01:00Z and 03:00Z as Asian trade stayed orderly. The European session rebuilt risk from 06:00Z, peaking again at 25% Tail at 09:00Z as the 30-year yield pushed to its post-2004 high, then settled back into the 22-24% band through the US pre-market. Stress stayed elevated throughout, in a 49-58% range, which is the signature of a difficult but still mean-reverting environment rather than a persistent one-way path.
outlookSummary: Tail is published below the 25% block threshold across all 24 forecast hours. The path steps up to 23% around the 17:00Z seven-year note auction and its immediate digestion, eases through the US close, and drops into the 17-19% green band overnight as the day's scheduled calendar is exhausted. It rebuilds from the European open on Friday toward 22% into the 12:30Z durable goods release and the 14:00Z final Michigan sentiment reading. Confidence decays gradually from 87% to 82% with distance from the assessment time. These are conditional forecasts, not assertions that any future price structure has been observed.

Retracement is working.
